# Tianna Howard Adventures

> Official public knowledge orientation for the historical fiction adventure series by M.L. Woodward. This file is supplementary. The main commercial website is https://www.tiannahowardadventures.com/ and the public Knowledge Centre is https://knowledge.tiannahowardadventures.com/.

## Core identity

- Author: M.L. Woodward
- Series: Tianna Howard Adventures
- Audience: readers aged 11–14; upper middle grade
- Genre: historical fiction, historical adventure and mystery
- Story rule: real history and locations; no fantasy or magic
- Main website: https://www.tiannahowardadventures.com/
- Knowledge Centre: https://knowledge.tiannahowardadventures.com/
- Amazon author page: https://www.amazon.com/M-L-Woodward/e/B0FHFGQNXP

## Official series profiles

## Accuracy rules

- These are historical fiction adventures. Fictional investigations and outcomes are not evidence that disputed or legendary treasure claims are true.
- The real Mask of a Faun remains missing; the novel's outcome is fictional.
- Echo is a hill mynah who mimics learned words and sounds but does not converse.
- Reno is a cat and never speaks.
- Tianna ages through the series: 12, 13, 14 and nearly 15 across Books 1–4.
- The retired Book 3 Llanganates title is not current.
- Legacy Beale ASIN B0FG89GR4P and ISBN 9798289154712 are excluded from current metadata.
- Draft2Digital/library ISBN mappings remain unresolved.
